messages:
Ava: Quick sync — planning deploy of runtime-optimizer v3.5 on 2026-03-20 22:00Z. Canary progression: 1% -> 10% -> 100% over 30m. Need final owners and smoke + rollback ack.
Jon: I can own the smoke checks for the first 30m. Will run scripts and validate traces. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll be rollback owner and on-call contact. If we need to revert I'll run the rollout undo and flip the feature flag.
Mika: Code review is green, pushed commit 8f7a3d2 with the kv-cache fix. CI fixed the flaky test.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline: ✅ tests 112/112, staging image pushed (registry.redwood/rt-opt:v3.5-20260320).
Ava: Short checklist (please ack):
- [ ] owners assigned (smoke / rollback / capacity)
- [ ] canary window + percentages posted
- [ ] smoke script + expected metrics documented
- [ ] rollback commands verified
- [ ] ops capacity confirmed
Jon: Ack owners assigned. I'll run `./scripts/smoke_runtime.sh canary` at T+5 after canary starts. Smoke steps: run load (~50qps), check p50/p95 < 150/500ms, no errors in traces.
Sam: Capacity confirmed. Autoscaler policy 3->30 GPUs, burst allowed. I'll watch queue depth during canary.
Theo: I'll monitor latency dashboards and alert if p95 > 600ms for 3 consecutive minutes. Call rollback if sustained.
Priya: Rollback plan (confirmed): 1) `kubectl rollout undo deployment/ri-runtime --to-revision=42` 2) flip config: `feature.gating.runtime_v3_5=false` 3) validate canaries back to baseline. I'll execute step 1+2 if needed.
Mika: FYI the tracing tag changed, use `service:ri-runtime,release:v3.5` when filtering.
Ava: Final ack list so far: Ava, Jon, Priya, Sam, Mika, Theo. If no objections by 21:30Z we lock window and proceed. Post any last-minute concerns here. :rocket:
